import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildePullback
import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentAffine

/-!
# Affine base change of quasicoherent sheaves

The affine structure theorem identifies pullback of a quasicoherent sheaf
with the associated sheaf of the scalar extension of its global sections.
Taking global sections gives the corresponding module comparison.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

variable {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S)

/-- Pullback of an affine quasicoherent sheaf is associated with the scalar
extension of its global sections. -/
noncomputable def quasicoherentPullbackIso (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).obj F ≅
      tilde ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).mapIso (asIso F.fromTildeΓ).symm ≪≫
    pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The affine pullback identification respects sheaf morphisms. -/
theorem quasicoherentPullbackIso_inv_naturality
    {F G : (Spec R).Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (f : F ⟶ G) :
    (tilde.functor S).map
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)) ≫
        (quasicoherentPullbackIso φ G).inv =
      (quasicoherentPullbackIso φ F).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map f := by
  change (tilde.functor S).map
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)) ≫
      ((pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj G)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map G.fromTildeΓ) =
    ((pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map f
  have hn := (pullbackSpecTildeNatIso φ).inv.naturality (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)
  change (tilde.functor S).map
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)) ≫
      (pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj G)).inv =
    (pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map
        ((tilde.functor R).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)) at hn
  erw [← Category.assoc, hn]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  have hc := Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans.naturality f
  exact congrArg (fun a => (pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)).inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map a) hc

/-- Global sections commute with affine scalar extension for a
quasicoherent sheaf. -/
noncomputable def quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) ≅
      moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).obj F) :=
  tilde.isoTop _ ≪≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.mapIso (quasicoherentPullbackIso φ F).symm

/-- The scalar-extension comparison is the adjoint of the canonical map
from the associated extended module to the pulled-back sheaf. -/
theorem quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso_hom (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso φ F).hom =
      (tilde.adjunction.homEquiv _ _)
        ((pullbackSpecTildeIso φ (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F)).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ) := by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Scalar extension of global sections and pullback of a sheaf morphism
agree under the affine comparison. -/
theorem quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso_hom_naturality
    {F G : (Spec R).Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (f : F ⟶ G) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f) ≫
        (quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso φ G).hom =
      (quasicoherentSectionsBaseChangeIso φ F).hom ≫
        moduleSpecΓFunctor.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map f) := by
  let a := (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)
  let b := (tilde.isoTop ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj G))).hom
  let c := (tilde.isoTop ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F))).hom
  let d := (tilde.functor S).map a
  let e := (quasicoherentPullbackIso φ G).inv
  let t := (quasicoherentPullbackIso φ F).inv
  let g := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map f
  change a ≫ (b ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map e) =
    (c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map t) ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map g
  have hn := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := S)).hom.naturality
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f))
  have hn' : a ≫ b = c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map d := hn
  have hp : d ≫ e = t ≫ g := quasicoherentPullbackIso_inv_naturality φ f
  calc
    a ≫ (b ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map e) =
        (a ≫ b) ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map e := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map d) ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map e :=
      congrArg (fun z => z ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map e) hn'
    _ = c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map (d ≫ e) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => c ≫ z) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map_comp d e).symm)
    _ = c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map (t ≫ g) :=
      congrArg (fun z => c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map z) hp
    _ = (c ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map t) ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map g :=
      (congrArg (fun z => c ≫ z) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map_comp t g)).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

end MilneLib
